core_obligations: Establish the equivalence of the three chartwise conditions by descent along surjective etale morphisms.
Prove the pointwise equivalence by comparing the strict local rings and reducing to the schemes case.

proof_roadmap.step: Set up a surjective etale chart and reduce the chartwise conditions.
Show the conditions are equivalent by etale descent.
Prove the pointwise criterion via the strict local rings.

difficulty_reason: The algebraic-spaces criterion for the Gorenstein property, structured exactly as the Cohen-Macaulay criterion: three chartwise conditions using surjective etale charts by schemes, plus a pointwise equivalence comparing the strict local rings of a point and its image. The proof establishes the equivalence of the chartwise conditions by etale descent and then proves the pointwise criterion by passing to the strict local rings and applying the schemes case there. The descent step together with the strict-local-ring comparison is the substance. Retained author proof at lines 6562-6609.
